name: Grade 7 Mathematics: Fractions
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to add and subtract fractions with different denominators
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to apply fractions in real-life situations
learningActivities: Demonstration: teacher models finding the LCM of denominators
Group work: learners add and subtract fractions using fraction cards
Application: learners solve real-life problems involving fractions
keyPoints: To add fractions with different denominators, find a common denominator first
Fractions must have the same denominator before adding or subtracting
commonMisconceptions: Adding denominators as well as numerators
Not simplifying answers to the lowest terms
lessonEvaluation: Learners add and subtract fractions and solve two real-life problems. Teacher assesses through written work.
teacherReflection: Good understanding shown. Emphasis on simplifying answers in the next lesson.
